units.source_text: 他走下了体育场两三级的大谷石①石阶，在石阶上坐了下来。

en.t: He walked down two or three steps of Oya stone from the athletic field and sat down on the stone steps.

units.source_text: 四周坐着四五个低班的同学，在倾听着他的讲述，听得入了迷。

en.t: Around him sat four or five younger students, listening to his story in rapt attention.

units.source_text: 5月的郁金香、香豌豆、银莲花、虞美人等各色的花，在斜坡的花圃里争妍斗艳。

en.t: May tulips, sweet peas, anemones, poppies, and flowers of every color vied in beauty in the flower beds on the slope.

units.source_text: 头顶上的朴树盛开着大朵的白花。

en.t: Overhead, the magnolia tree was in full bloom with large white flowers.
